title: Inside the study workflow → explanatory call templates

nodes.title: Ingestion
nodes.summary: Build the corpus, then georeference the zoning plan.
nodes.orderNote: Preparation CLI defaults to corpus → georef. Each can run alone; corpus completes before georef starts.

steps.purpose: Read the configured PDFs and heading rules
steps.detail: Validate corpus settings. The active corpus contains regulation, zoning plan and OAP PDFs; legal force is supplied separately to reading tools.
steps.arguments: corpus_cfg: configured documents, classifier and splitters
steps.result: CorpusSettings

steps.purpose: Sample native text before full extraction
steps.detail: Scan page text; report filename, metadata title, total pages and text-page count. Include the first 3 nonempty text pages, at most 1500 characters each.
steps.condition: Only when kind OR title is missing.
steps.arguments: path, sample_pages=3, sample_chars=1500
steps.result: Plain-text PDF description; no OCR or image input

image.alt: SOMMAIRE of the PLU reglement: TITRE I and II and the La Vallee zone list with page numbers
image.caption: PLU reglement, page 2 (SOMMAIRE), rendered from the PDF at 300 dpi
image.provenance: ressources/plu_reglement_91272_20210706.pdf p.2, clip (60,96,535,~300) pt rendered at 300 dpi (pymupdf)

steps.purpose: Choose document kind and title
steps.detail: The closure from make_classifier returns structured Classification. Keep supplied overrides; skip classification only when both kind AND title are configured.
steps.condition: Only when kind OR title is missing.
steps.arguments: sample from text_sample
steps.result: kind: regulatory_text | zoning_map | oap; title

steps.purpose: Extract all native text and layout lines
steps.detail: PyMuPDF reads sorted dict lines: page, text, x0/y0, font size/name and same-font lead. Image-only pages keep empty text; PDF page indices start at 1.
steps.arguments: path, doc=document.id
steps.result: Extraction(pages, lines); no OCR or embeddings

image.alt: PLU page 326 with the Moulon - UMG running header, article 8.2 and article 9
image.caption: PLU reglement, page 326: header, 8.2 and ARTICLE 9 text that gets extracted

steps.purpose: Build the configured heading hierarchy
steps.detail: Header rules run first; body uses first matching regex/style/context rule. Strip headers/footers, join wrapped headings, keep preamble and own-text sections; drop repeated open headings.
steps.condition: Only if a splitter exists for the classified kind; zoning_map has none.
steps.arguments: doc, extraction.lines, splitter for kind
steps.result: Sections with stable unique IDs, heading paths, zone/article and page ranges
steps.checks: Regulation: titre → sector → zone → article → part → term. OAP: chapter. Continuations: up to 2 / 1 lines.

image.alt: PLU page 320 with the Moulon - UMG header, the Zone UMG - Joliot-Curie title and the zone introduction
image.caption: PLU reglement, page 320: zone title and intro that open the UMG section

steps.purpose: Persist pages and sections for later reading
steps.detail: After all configured PDFs, assemble Corpus and write corpus.json. The separate georef routine then loads the plan image.
steps.arguments: corpus, root / settings.dir
steps.result: data/gif-sur-yvette@2021-07-06/corpus.json

steps.purpose: Configure plan registration
steps.detail: Validate settings, resolve the plan PDF from corpus.documents and instantiate CommuneBoundaryClient. Unknown document IDs fail.
steps.arguments: corpus.georef: document=plu_reglement_graphique, page=1, insee=91272, crs=EPSG:2154
steps.result: GeorefSettings and boundary client

steps.purpose: Load the full-resolution plan
steps.detail: Decode a covering embedded scan without resampling; otherwise render at configured DPI. Convert to RGB.
steps.arguments: plan PDF, page=1, render_dpi, scan_min_coverage
steps.result: RGB page pixmap and full pixel dimensions

steps.purpose: Mask the coloured commune interior
steps.detail: Average 4x4 blocks; threshold channel spread, close labels/lines, keep largest component, fill holes, open thin spurs and keep largest component again. This does not classify zone meanings.
steps.arguments: downscale=4, min_saturation=30, close_px=5 x2, open_px=3 x2
steps.result: Reduced-resolution boolean commune mask

steps.purpose: Fetch the official commune outline
steps.detail: Cached IGN API Carto cadastre request with code_insee. Keep the largest polygon part and project WGS84 to Lambert-93.
steps.arguments: insee=91272; endpoint=/api/cadastre/commune
steps.result: Commune polygon in EPSG:2154

steps.purpose: Fit ground coordinates to plan pixels
steps.detail: Try four moment-based starts (mirror and axis orientations); refine six affine parameters with robust least squares against mask-edge distances; keep lowest cost. Empty mask fails.
steps.arguments: mask, outline, sample_step_m=10, robust_scale_px=3 (soft_l1)
steps.result: Ground-metres to reduced-pixels affine matrix

image.alt: Zoning plan crop around the Moulon area after registration, with the commune outline in purple
image.caption: Registered plan around UMG, fit check (georef diagnostic)

steps.purpose: Save transform, errors and diagnostics
steps.detail: Measure outline distances both ways; scale matrix to full pixels, compute IoU and mean/max metre errors. Save JSON atomically, then mask.png and boundary.png.
steps.arguments: matrix, image dimensions, CRS, scale, IoU, errors, boundary source, creation date
steps.result: data/gif-sur-yvette@2021-07-06/georef/plu_reglement_graphique.json; outputs/georef/{mask,boundary}.png
steps.checks: Registration metrics are stored, not an accuracy acceptance threshold. Affine fitting does not read the legend or determine the site zone.

nodes.title: Orchestrator
nodes.summary: Coordinates the whole study and resolves interpretations.
nodes.orderNote: Active throughout. Prescribed dependencies: site → zone → three document tasks → decisions → architect → gate; focused loops may repeat.

steps.purpose: Load the study recipe
steps.detail: Load the configured study playbook before work. This is a tool-using agent following instructions, not a hard-coded stage scheduler.
steps.arguments: name="study"
steps.result: Study instructions with configured free-text language

steps.purpose: Clarify consequential missing facts or interpretations
steps.detail: Batch program questions early; later batch interpretations with recommendations. The playbook allows at most two calls; unavailable or unanswered choices are resolved by the agent.
steps.condition: Tool available and missing facts or disputed readings affect the result.
steps.arguments: questions: stable id, kind, question, why, options, recommended
steps.result: User answers; unresolved choices retain agent rationale

steps.purpose: Delegate surveyor, then zoning analyst
steps.detail: Give address, program and known facts. Wait for site before zoning; zoning receives parcel IDs. A poor address match may require clarification and redelegation.
steps.arguments: subagent_type="surveyor", description=context; then "zoning_analyst" with site parcel IDs
steps.result: site and zone artifacts; replies are summaries

image.alt: Chat UI showing the surveyor's accepted answer for parcel 91272000CR0247
image.caption: Surveyor answer in the chat UI (completed default run)
image.provenance: artifacts/default-case-demo-clean-raw.mp4 normalised to 30 fps (2880x1800), frame at 24.2 s (02-surveyor shot)

steps.purpose: Read full findings before dependent work
steps.detail: Read zone before document delegation. After the three document tasks, read notes.rules, notes.oap and notes.destinations; read focused extra notes when requested.
steps.condition: Repeated when a dependent stage needs an accepted artifact.
steps.arguments: name="zone" or "notes.rules" / "notes.oap" / "notes.destinations"
steps.result: Full typed artifact, beyond the task reply summary

steps.purpose: Start three separate document contexts after zoning
steps.detail: Issue rules, oap and destinations doc_analyst tasks in the same message. Each gets zone, applying legend labels, parcel IDs, program facts and stable building labels.
steps.arguments: subagent_type="doc_analyst", description=label + aim + topics + context + documents
steps.result: notes.rules, notes.oap, notes.destinations; prescribed parallel tasks

image.alt: Chat UI showing the document analyst's rules answer
image.caption: Document analyst answer in the chat UI (default run)
image.provenance: artifacts/default-case-demo-clean-raw.mp4 normalised to 30 fps (2880x1800), frame at 41.4 s (04-documents shot)

steps.purpose: Reconcile evidence and retain one interpretation
steps.detail: Model reasoning: regime/OAP → destination and verdict per building → parking → conditions → open points → interpretations → gaps. Copy open-point questions into ambiguities.
steps.arguments: Read artifacts plus program facts and any user answers
steps.result: Study decisions, cited claims and resolved ambiguities
steps.checks: Model judgment, not a callable. Focused extra doc_analyst tasks use new labels when evidence is missing or contradictory.

steps.purpose: Delegate the retained program to the architect
steps.detail: Provide exact building labels, retained destinations and OAP applicability. Missing mandatory rules require new document notes then another architect task. Skip architecture when all proposed uses are prohibited; submit the cited negative study without an envelope.
steps.condition: After decisions; repeat if required evidence or envelope needs repair.
steps.arguments: subagent_type="architect", description=program + labels/destinations + OAP applies + extra notes labels
steps.result: envelope artifact or precise missing-rule request

image.alt: Chat UI showing the architect's answer with retained rules and layout
image.caption: Architect answer in the chat UI (default run)
image.provenance: artifacts/default-case-demo-clean-raw.mp4 normalised to 30 fps (2880x1800), frame at 64.4 s (05-architect shot)

steps.purpose: Submit the assembled study to the gate
steps.detail: Submit decisions and citations; site/envelope figures come from code. On rejection, repair the named issue and use revise_study; on acceptance, repeat returned figures exactly.
steps.arguments: Study fields: address, program, regime, admissibility, parking, conditions, ambiguities, summary
steps.result: Accepted VerifiedStudy or actionable errors and retained draft

image.alt: Accepted study view: site area, zone, volumes and the 3D proposal
image.caption: Accepted study as shown in the chat UI (default run)
image.provenance: artifacts/default-case-demo-clean-raw.mp4 normalised to 30 fps (2880x1800), frame at 72.7 s (06-findings shot)

nodes.title: Surveyor
nodes.summary: Choose parcels; code builds the metric site.
nodes.orderNote: Prompt sequence: geocode → nearby parcels → model shortlist → describe → optional aerial/strip check → submit. Code finalizes inside submit/revise.

steps.purpose: Find a matching address candidate
steps.detail: Match house number, street and town, preferably housenumber. Stop without submission if no reliable candidate; the orchestrator handles clarification.
steps.arguments: query=case address
steps.result: Candidates with label, kind, longitude and latitude

steps.purpose: List cadastral candidates around the address point
steps.detail: Code queries a configured 50 m metric radius and sorts by distance then ID. A point on the street can make the closest parcel a misleading strip.
steps.arguments: longitude=candidate.longitude, latitude=candidate.latitude
steps.result: IDs, contenance_m2, distance_m, contains_point, mean_width_m, touches

image.alt: IGN map with the nine cadastral candidates around the address point outlined in red
image.caption: IGN map, parcels returned by find_parcels (50 m radius)
image.provenance: site_view tool (agent.tools.geo.view.site_view_tool), ids = 9 candidates of find_parcels, kind=map, scale=parcel

steps.purpose: Discard implausible parcels before detailed inspection
steps.detail: Use proximity, dimensions and program plausibility. mean_width_m near 1 m or less and a tiny area suggest a strip. Nearest does not automatically mean selected.
steps.result: Plausible parcel IDs to describe
steps.checks: Model judgment only; this label is not an agent tool or code function.

image.alt: Aerial photo with the same nine candidate parcels outlined
image.caption: Aerial photo of the same candidate parcels
image.provenance: site_view tool (agent.tools.geo.view.site_view_tool), ids = 9 candidates, kind=aerial, scale=parcel

steps.purpose: Inspect shapes, connectivity and street-side neighbours
steps.detail: Fetch the shortlist, assess its union and inspect adjacent parcels. A disconnected group returns separate part areas instead of a one-piece site description.
steps.arguments: ids=shortlisted IDs, longitude/latitude=chosen candidate point
steps.result: Parcel facts, one_piece, union area, edge totals and neighbours

image.alt: IGN map close-up of parcel CR0247 and the strip along its western side
image.caption: IGN map, parcel 91272000CR0247 (cadastre outline)

steps.purpose: Resolve parcel doubts and inspect a possible public strip
steps.detail: Inspect chosen IDs, adding a thin street-side neighbour when needed. Declare public_parcels only with pavement/verge/road evidence and a reason; record contestable assumptions.
steps.condition: Optional when selection is uncertain or a street-side strip needs visual inspection; may repeat.
steps.arguments: ids=site IDs plus candidate strip ID, kind="aerial"
steps.result: Parcel outlines over aerial imagery; model judgment on strip use

image.alt: Aerial photo of parcel CR0247 with its outline, buildings and lawn
image.caption: Aerial photo, parcel 91272000CR0247 (IGN orthophoto)

steps.purpose: Submit the choice and its evidence
steps.detail: Pass the geocoder label, selected IDs, rejected alternatives, rationale and assumptions; optionally public neighbours. The model supplies no geometry or legal edge labels.
steps.arguments: address=geocoder label, parcel_ids, rationale, assumptions, public_parcels=[{id,reason}]
steps.result: Runs ParcelChoice validation and parcel_finalizer

steps.purpose: Recheck the choice and build one connected metric polygon
steps.detail: Re-geocode label → fetch/project IDs → connected union → neighbours → neutral edges, area and citations. parcel_finalizer then checks declared public parcels are across site edges.
steps.arguments: Validated ParcelChoice; configured metric CRS and tolerances
steps.result: Accepted site with polygon, area, parcels, neutral edges and geometric provenance
steps.checks: Reject bad label/IDs, unusable or disjoint geometry, selected/non-neighbour public IDs. Does not prove ownership/public status.

steps.purpose: Correct only rejected parcel fields
steps.detail: Apply edits to the retained draft, then rerun schema and the same finalizer: address recheck, parcel fetch, union, edges and public-neighbour checks. Stop after site accepted.
steps.condition: Only after rejection; not a mandatory stage or fixed call count.
steps.arguments: edits=[{path: rejected field path, value: corrected value}]
steps.result: Corrected accepted site or another rejection

nodes.title: Zoning analyst
nodes.summary: Read the legend, inspect the outlined site, submit zoning.
nodes.orderNote: After accepted site: catalogue → overview/legend → plan_site → zone/overlay reading → submit. Zooms repeat; contextual maps are optional.

steps.purpose: Find the zoning plan
steps.detail: Identify document ID, page and image-only status before opening the plan.
steps.arguments: No arguments
steps.result: Document IDs, kind, pages, legal force and image-only status

steps.purpose: Open the plan overview
steps.detail: Locate the legend. Pixel rulers define all zoom and evidence coordinates.
steps.arguments: doc=plan ID, page=PDF page index
steps.result: Page overview with pixel rulers

image.alt: Overview of the zoning plan: coloured zones, legend and zone tables
image.caption: Plan de zonage, page 1, overview as opened by the zoning analyst

steps.purpose: Read every legend item
steps.detail: Zoom until every zone label, hatching, protection, perimeter, reserved site and line/symbol is readable.
steps.condition: Repeat as needed to make the legend readable.
steps.arguments: doc=plan ID, page, region=[x0,y0,x1,y1] from overview rulers
steps.result: Detailed legend labels and visual encodings

image.alt: Legend of the zoning plan: zone limits, wooded areas, flood risk, OAP sector and other items
image.caption: Plan de zonage, legend items to check against the site

steps.purpose: See the site outlined on the plan
steps.detail: Return close-up (+80 m) and context (+600 m) crops with thin red merged-parcel outline, overview regions and stated uncertainty. Enlargement is capped at 4x full pixels.
steps.arguments: ids=accepted site parcel IDs
steps.result: Two outlined images; reusable regions; position uncertainty = 2 x georef mean_error_m
steps.checks: Requires the saved corpus.georef.output JSON. Missing file returns a tool error directing ingest georef; the tool can be built without it. Page-size mismatch also requires rebuilding. No transform is fitted during this call.

image.alt: Close-up of the zoning plan with the parcel outlined in red inside zone UMG
image.caption: Plan de zonage, close-up of CR0247 outlined (plan_site tool)
image.provenance: plan_site tool (agent.tools.plan.site), ids=[91272000CR0247], close-up image; outputs/georef/plan_site_CR0247_close.png

steps.purpose: Project parcels and render crops
steps.detail: Inside plan_site: load transform, fetch parcels, union shapes, map all rings to full pixels, check page size, clip square crops and render outlines with rulers.
steps.arguments: Saved transform, surveyed parcel polygons, ground margins, page scale
steps.result: Outlined crop PNGs stored via ImageStore
steps.checks: Missing/off-page geometry or incompatible page size fails. These internals are not separate agent tools.

image.alt: Wider zoning plan crop around the parcel with neighbouring zones UM3, UM4, UM5, UMG and NF
image.caption: Plan de zonage, context crop around CR0247 (plan_site tool)

steps.purpose: Read the complete printed zone code
steps.detail: Zoom/pan through the continuous bounded zone holding the outline until its label and suffix are legible. Colour alone cannot identify the zone; zoom removes the red outline.
steps.condition: Repeat until legible; record uncertainty near boundaries.
steps.arguments: doc, page, region from plan_site or overview rulers
steps.result: Exact code and any zone-boundary ambiguity

image.alt: Zoning plan crop showing the parcel outline and the printed zone code UMG
image.caption: Plan de zonage, parcel CR0247 and printed code UMG

steps.purpose: Test every non-zone legend item
steps.detail: Compare each item with the outline. Follow district perimeters around the context crop; zoom/pan as needed. Record ambiguity for lines within stated uncertainty.
steps.arguments: Legend, close/context crops, additional zooms
steps.result: One applies true/false entry per non-zone item; ambiguities
steps.checks: Model visual judgment, not a callable or automatic affine/legend interpretation.

steps.purpose: Inspect optional town context
steps.detail: Use the real-world map only when surrounding geography helps. Default imagery remains IGN WMS Plan IGN; it does not replace the zoning plan.
steps.arguments: ids=accepted site parcel IDs, kind="map", scale="town"
steps.result: Town contextual map with site outlines
steps.condition: Optional contextual aid; no required position in the sequence.

image.alt: IGN map of the town at 3 km width with the parcel outlined in red
image.caption: IGN map, town scale (3 km), parcel CR0247

steps.purpose: Inspect optional local context
steps.detail: Inspect a closer map when needed to understand surroundings. site_view also supports aerial imagery via IGN WMS orthophotos.
steps.arguments: ids=accepted site parcel IDs, kind="map", scale="neighbourhood"
steps.result: Neighbourhood context with parcel outlines
steps.condition: Optional contextual aid; no required position in the sequence.

image.alt: Aerial photo of the surrounding blocks, 500 m wide, with the parcel outlined
image.caption: Aerial photo, neighbourhood scale (500 m), parcel CR0247

steps.purpose: Submit zone and close-up evidence
steps.detail: Submit exact zone, every non-zone legend item, rationale, plan_site close-up region and ambiguities with chosen interpretation/reason. Code checks schema and region bounds.
steps.arguments: zone, overlays=[{item,applies,note}], rationale, region=plan_site close-up, ambiguities
steps.result: zone artifact or errors
steps.checks: Bounds do not establish correct zone reading or exhaustive legend coverage. Stop only after zone accepted.

steps.purpose: Repair rejected fields or evidence coordinates
steps.detail: Edit only listed errors and run the same validation again. End when zone accepted.
steps.condition: Only after rejection.
steps.arguments: edits=[{path: rejected field path, value: corrected value}]
steps.result: Accepted zone or further errors

nodes.title: Document analysts
nodes.summary: Three contexts read rules, OAP and destinations.
nodes.orderNote: Only after zoning finishes and zone is read. Three prescribed tasks run in parallel; each navigates, reads and checks its own scope, with adaptive revisits.

steps.purpose: Choose sources within the delegated scope
steps.detail: rules: regulation/general provisions/glossary. oap: OAP plus plan/perimeter comparison. destinations: regulation definitions and zone uses. Each task carries its own context and topics.
steps.arguments: No arguments; respect task.documents
steps.result: Document IDs and conformity/compatibility legal force

steps.purpose: Navigate to relevant chapters and articles
steps.detail: Choose headings for the aim and context. Repeat with parent to descend; do not assume snippets or section titles contain all exceptions.
steps.arguments: doc=permitted document ID, parent=optional section ID
steps.result: Section IDs, heading paths and page ranges

steps.purpose: Read whole provisions and follow cross-references
steps.detail: Active full_sections mode includes descendants. Read zone provisions, introductions, exceptions, general rules and definitions. Replies retain PDF page markers; text cap is 120000 characters.
steps.condition: Repeat for referenced chapters and glossary entries.
steps.arguments: section_id=ID returned by navigation/search
steps.result: Full section and descendants with page markers

image.alt: PLU page 326: article 10 (hauteur maximale) of zone UMG with its definition and general rule
image.caption: PLU reglement p.326: UMG article 10, height 20 m / R+5

steps.purpose: Find terms and rules outside the current chapter
steps.detail: BM25 keyword search returns up to 8 hits and 300-character snippets. Search is an adaptive aid; read the full section or page before citing. No embedding retrieval.
steps.condition: When a term, use or cross-reference needs locating; may repeat.
steps.arguments: query=source-language keywords, doc=optional permitted document ID
steps.result: Ranked section IDs, page-specific snippets and ranges

steps.purpose: Verify exact quotes and page boundaries
steps.detail: Read native raw text, including running headers/footers, at most 4 pages per call. Cite 1-based PDF page markers, not printed footer numbers.
steps.condition: For quote checks, page breaks or text outside sections; repeat on rejected quotes.
steps.arguments: doc, start=first PDF page, end=last PDF page inclusive
steps.result: Page text for contiguous verbatim quotes

image.alt: OAP page 36, chapter 8 Le quartier Joliot Curie, heading La programmation and its first paragraphs
image.caption: OAP, page 36 (chapter 8, Joliot Curie): La programmation
image.provenance: ressources/oap_91272_20210706.pdf p.36, clip (22,56,560,283) pt at 300 dpi

steps.purpose: Read information that exists only in diagrams
steps.detail: Render the page overview with rulers. When perimeter location matters, compare using site_view(ids, kind="map", scale=...) from the task context. Textual rules use text citations.
steps.condition: When diagrams, maps or image-only content are relevant.
steps.arguments: doc=permitted document ID, page=PDF page index
steps.result: Page image and coordinate frame; optional site_view comparison

image.alt: PLU page 377 diagrams: building height measured to the eaves and to the acrotere
image.caption: PLU page 377: eaves and acrotere height diagrams (image-only content)

steps.purpose: Read small diagram labels and retain evidence views
steps.detail: Zoom regions in overview coordinates; repeat as needed. Store relevant regions as note.views; an OAP perimeter reading compares the diagram with contextual geography.
steps.condition: When diagram detail needs magnification; may repeat.
steps.arguments: doc, page, region=[x0,y0,x1,y1]
steps.result: Readable detail; views=[{doc,page,region}] for diagram-based notes

image.alt: Zoomed OAP page 34 diagram showing public space principles of the Joliot Curie quarter
image.caption: OAP p.34, zoomed diagram saved as evidence (default run)

steps.purpose: Submit cited notes and unresolved questions
steps.detail: Copy label/topics; each note has topic, text, citations and optional views. Open points carry question/options/why. Code checks declared topic coverage, quotes and view bounds.
steps.arguments: label, topics, notes=[{topic,text,citations,views}], open_points=[{question,options,why,citations}]
steps.result: notes.<label> accepted or field errors
steps.checks: After rejection: reread affected pages, then revise_notes(edits). Coverage is checked against submitted topics, not original task.

nodes.title: Architect
nodes.summary: Encode cited rules and a layout; preview computed geometry.
nodes.orderNote: After retained destinations and notes. Read → encode rules/layout → preview and adjust → submit. Missing required rules return to document work. Wholly prohibited programs skip this node.

steps.purpose: Read the surveyed site and cited rule notes
steps.detail: Read site, notes.rules, notes.destinations and named extras; read notes.oap when applicable. Configured architect tools cannot read source documents directly.
steps.arguments: name="site", "notes.rules", "notes.destinations", named extra notes; conditional "notes.oap"
steps.result: Site geometry and source-backed rule evidence

steps.purpose: Translate cited provisions into typed envelope rules
steps.detail: Encode setbacks per road/side/rear, window cases, max(min_m, height_ratio × H), building heights/storeys, spacing, footprint and green ratios. Copy citations from notes.
steps.result: EnvelopeRules; missing mandatory setback/height returns for more notes
steps.checks: Model judgment, not a callable. Numeric limits require citations.

steps.purpose: Place the retained buildings and explain choices
steps.detail: Set order, cut, first_share, facing_windows and optional heights_m. OAP prescriptions shape layout with citations/how; they do not overwrite rules.
steps.result: Layout with building labels, geometry choices and reasons
steps.checks: Model judgment, not a callable. Keep building labels and height maxima consistent.

image.alt: Site plan of the two proposed buildings on the parcel in the chat UI
image.caption: Site plan with the two buildings (default run)
image.provenance: artifacts/default-case-demo-clean-raw.mp4 normalised to 30 fps (2880x1800), frame at 107.8 s (09-site-plan shot)

steps.purpose: Inspect the computed plan and adjust the proposal
steps.detail: Code labels edges and computes bounds/proposal; the model inspects placement, shape, warnings and fit, then may adjust layout. Preview stores no accepted envelope artifact.
steps.condition: Repeat when preview reveals a layout issue; no fixed call count.
steps.arguments: rules=EnvelopeRules, layout=Layout
steps.result: Computed figures plus proposal map; disposable preview

image.alt: 3D view of the proposal: two buildings of 20 m on the parcel
image.caption: Computed proposal, 3D view (default run)
image.provenance: artifacts/default-case-demo-clean-raw.mp4 normalised to 30 fps (2880x1800), frame at 116.3 s (10-proposal-3d shot)

steps.purpose: Submit rules and layout for a stored envelope
steps.detail: Validate EnvelopeSubmission and finalize using site_envelope. If rejected, correct and resubmit the complete result; no revise_envelope is configured.
steps.arguments: rules, layout, open_points=[{question,options,why,...}]
steps.result: envelope: EnvelopeStudy or rejection
steps.checks: Missing mandatory note-backed inputs: stop and request evidence. fits=false is a computed result, not automatic rejection.

steps.purpose: Compute bounds, split footprints and raise massings
steps.detail: Inside preview/submit: label edges, compute rule-based bounds, split the proposal with spacing, trim contained polygons under area caps, then recompute height slices, areas and volumes. The final gate uses the same path.
steps.arguments: Metric site polygon, labelled boundaries, rules, layout, settings
steps.result: Bounds and proposal with footprints, massings, volumes, fits and warnings
steps.checks: 1 m slices; largest remaining piece retained; height-dependent setbacks. Geometry models submitted rules, not their legal meaning. Area caps use conservative clipping, not a global optimizer; polygons and numeric areas now agree. Saved demo images predate this correction.

image.alt: 3D view of the envelope bound with windows
image.caption: Envelope bound with windows, 3D view (default run)
image.provenance: artifacts/default-case-demo-clean-raw.mp4 normalised to 30 fps (2880x1800), frame at 124.5 s (11-windows-3d shot)

nodes.title: Validation
nodes.summary: Check dependencies and evidence, recompute, then store VerifiedStudy.
nodes.orderNote: Deterministic inside submit_study/revise_study: schema → findings → accumulated checks → recompute → save crops → VerifiedStudy. Repair is conditional.

steps.purpose: Validate the submitted decision schema
steps.detail: The shared pipeline validates before finalization. Required fields, enums and model constraints are enforced; invalid submissions retain a rejected draft without storing acceptance.
steps.arguments: Top-level Study fields supplied to submit_study
steps.result: Validated Study or schema errors
steps.checks: Does not independently compare request address, program or building count.

steps.purpose: Require site, zone, notes and envelope deliveries
steps.detail: Require site, zone and notes.rules/oap/destinations; also read extra notes labels and enforce note labels against artifact keys. Require an envelope unless every proposed use is prohibited. Standard note-topic minimums come from shared policy configuration; custom labels remain model-declared.
steps.arguments: Current graph artifacts, configured StudyInputs
steps.result: Typed Findings or missing-delivery errors

steps.purpose: Require a retained answer for every delivered open point
steps.detail: Match notes, envelope and zoning questions to study ambiguities after case/whitespace normalization. This checks retention, not the quality of an interpretation.
steps.arguments: Study ambiguities and open_points(findings, inputs)
steps.result: Unanswered-question errors accumulated with envelope/citation errors

steps.purpose: Check building consistency and citation provenance
steps.detail: Require study zone and applying overlays to match zoning findings. Envelope rule citations must occur in notes; layout citations in notes.oap. Check layout labels/heights and admissibility building labels when an envelope is required.
steps.arguments: study, findings, inputs
steps.result: Consistency/provenance errors
steps.checks: Does not establish that a numeric input follows from the cited rule meaning.

steps.purpose: Match study and envelope regulatory quotes to corpus pages
steps.detail: Default reject policy: normalized fuzzy score ≥0.9 and every quoted number present with multiplicity; same cited page only. Raster documents bypass text checks as not text-verifiable.
steps.arguments: Study and EnvelopeCitations; policy=reject, min_score=0.9, neighbour_pages=0, check_raster=false
steps.result: CitationCheck records or accumulated rejection errors
steps.checks: Raster bypass: verified=false, score=0, text_verifiable=false. A matching quote does not prove the interpretation.

steps.purpose: Recompute every envelope figure from the delivered inputs
steps.detail: For programs with an eligible use, relabel edges and recompute the envelope from site, rules and layout. Wholly prohibited programs keep labelled boundaries but omit the envelope; stale architect artifacts are ignored.
steps.arguments: findings.site, delivered.rules, delivered.layout, geometry, settings, open_points
steps.result: Fresh boundaries and EnvelopeStudy
steps.checks: fits=false and agent-resolved ambiguities do not independently block acceptance. A wholly prohibited study has envelope=null.

steps.purpose: Save evidence regions and assemble VerifiedStudy
steps.detail: Save unique zone region and note views from full-resolution renders, resizing as configured. Then construct VerifiedStudy; shared pipeline stores study and returns recomputed figures.
steps.arguments: evidence_regions(findings, inputs), images, crops_dir
steps.result: VerifiedStudy with study, site, boundaries, zone, envelope, citation_checks and evidence
steps.checks: Bounds/saveability prove neither visual correctness nor planning permission. Report rendering occurs after accepted study.

steps.purpose: Repair a rejected draft and rerun the same gate
steps.detail: Apply edits; redelegate the named producer if an artifact needs repair. Empty edits recheck after repaired deliveries. The entire pipeline runs again; stop after study accepted.
steps.condition: Only when submit_study/revise_study was rejected; not a mandatory final stage.
steps.arguments: edits at listed field paths; edits=[] when only delivered artifacts changed
steps.result: Another rejection or accepted VerifiedStudy
